'''Nol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a member of the the [[Imperial Guard]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Nol and a contingent of the Guard and other Imperial Forces was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] on the orders of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] in order to combat the [[Dread Host]], the enthralled forces of the rogue [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Nol was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 1.5, where he is part of the mission "Horror on Belsavis" that introduces Imperial players to Section X.<ref name="TOR" />
